thread:
sarah.ops: FYI - detected a partition on the usage-events topic in eu-west-1 around 2026-03-10T02:40Z. Consumer group laged ~18h. Metric delta showing ~210k missing usage events vs dashboards. Investigating impact on invoices. :eyes:

mike.billing: Oof. Which invoice window is affected? any high-value customers hit?

olivia.support: Customers have reported token undercounting in dashboard vs billing for yesterday. I’ve got two escalations open (ACME & NovaHealth). Need repro and ETA to reply.

raj.eng: Root cause: broker flapped and partition reassigned; our consumer group didn't fast-forward offsets due to a bad checkpoint. We have offsets 1,234,567 -> 1,450,001 pending. Can run targeted replay/backfill.

liz.custsuccess: Can we confirm we didn't double-bill if backfill runs? Need guaranteed idempotency before committing to ledger.

raj.eng: Plan proposal:
- Dry-run replay of the offset range to a staging ledger using replay_tool.
- Deduplicate by event_id (we already include event_id in payload).
- Compare counts: staging vs dashboards vs invoices.
- When satisfied, apply to production ledger and re-run billing aggregation.

sarah.ops: Sounds good. Add guardrails: small batch first, monitoring, and automatic pause on >1% unexpected delta.

raj.eng: Commands I will run (dry-run first):

```
./replay_tool \ 
  --topic usage-events \ 
  --from-offset 1234567 \ 
  --to-offset 1450001 \ 
  --consumer-group backfill-staging \ 
  --dry-run \ 
  --output staging_20260310.ndjson
```

Then a verification query (staging DB):
```
SELECT count(*) AS replay_count, count(DISTINCT event_id) AS unique_events 
FROM staging_billing_events 
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-10T02:40:00Z' AND ts <= '2026-03-11T23:59:59Z';
```

mike.billing: After dry-run, what's the expected invoice delta magnitude? we need to prepare credit notes if customers were underbilled.

olivia.support: Also include a customer-visible note template and an internal timeline for updates. ACME is sensitive to any billing changes.

raj.eng: Estimate: ~210k events -> ~3.1M tokens equivalent. For ACME/NovaHealth we expect <1% of their monthly usage each. Will surface exact per-customer deltas post dry-run.

replay-bot: Job queued: backfill-staging-1940001234 (dry-run). ETA: ~45m based on current throughput. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

liz.custsuccess: Please tag me when you have per-customer deltas. I'll draft outreach and any credits.

sarah.ops: Monitoring checklist for the run:
- streaming latency and throughput on replay workers
- staging ledger size and write errors
- duplicate event rate (should be 0 after dedupe)
- compare token counts vs dashboards (within 0.5% for dry-run)

raj.eng: Running dry-run now. I’ll post logs and a short CSV with per-customer deltas when ready. If everything looks good, next steps:
1) run a small production write for a 30m offset window and validate ledger reconciliation
2) escalate to full window apply
3) run billing aggregation job and validate invoices in staging

olivia.support: ETA to customers for initial update?

liz.custsuccess: We can send a heads-up: "We detected delayed usage ingestion affecting timestamps X–Y. We're replaying events and will confirm impact within 2 hours." Keeps them calm.

mike.billing: Keep finance looped. If we need to issue credits, tell me the list and amounts after reconciliation.

replay-bot: backfill-staging-1940001234 - dry-run completed. Stats: attempted=210234, written=210234 (staging), duplicates_detected=0. Runtime: 39m.

raj.eng: Dry-run looks clean. Staging counts match dashboard-derived counts within 0.3% after dedupe. Generating per-customer delta CSV now.

sarah.ops: Good. Proceed with canary write to prod ledger for offsets 1234567-1237567 (30m window). Can we add a safety flag to abort if ledger_write_error > 0?

raj.eng: Yes. Will run with --max-errors=0 and manual approval step. Command:
```
./replay_tool \ 
  --topic usage-events \ 
  --from-offset 1234567 \ 
  --to-offset 1237567 \ 
  --consumer-group backfill-prod-canary \ 
  --apply-prod \ 
  --max-errors 0
```

liz.custsuccess: Once canary completes, I'll prepare customer messages and suggested credits.

olivia.support: I'll update the two open escalations with estimated timeline + mitigation plan.

mike.billing: Finance on standby. If any invoice adjustments needed, we'll batch them next billing cycle unless urgent.

raj.eng: Canary started. Monitoring hooks enabled. Posting logs to #eng-runtime/replay-logs.

replay-bot: backfill-prod-canary-1940001234 - started.

sarah.ops: Action items captured:
- raj.eng: run canary, post CSV (in 1h)
- liz.custsuccess: draft customer comms and credit plan
- mike.billing: prepare finance approval flow for credits
- olivia.support: update customers and close escalations after canary

sarah.ops: If canary passes, schedule full backfill overnight (low-traffic window) and run billing aggregation in the morning. If any anomalous delta >1% for a top-10 customer, abort and escalate to execs. :lock:

raj.eng: Acknowledged. Posting final per-customer deltas in 15m.

liz.custsuccess: Thanks team. I'll standby for the CSV and craft two tailored messages for ACME/NovaHealth.

olivia.support: Noted. Updating the two tickets now.

mike.billing: Thanks. Keep records of all runs (job id, offsets, checksums) for audit trail.

sarah.ops: Closing thread on decisions for now — continuing execution in run logs. Will re-open if any deviation. :white_check_mark:
